coin.title: Official Restrike: Ducaton 2021 Gold 2 Ounce – Royal Delft Edition
coin.description: In 2021, the Royal Dutch Mint Ducaton is found in the familiar Royal Delft earthenware. The Delft Blue coin holder depicts classic Dutch scenery: a flat landscape with water, a windmill and beautiful flowers. We salute the Dutch landscape with this design. The artisanal coin holders by Royal Delft have become true collector’s items on their own. The Ducaton in Silver Proof comes with a uniquely numbered Certificate of Authenticity. Hand-painted Royal Delft coin holder In 2021, the Royal Dutch Mint Ducaton is found in the familiar Royal Delft earthenware. The Delft Blue coin holder depicts classic Dutch scenery: a flat landscape with water, a windmill and beautiful flowers. We salute the Dutch landscape with this design. The artisanal coin holders by Royal Delft have become true collector’s items on their own. The coin holder with the Ducaton in Gold Proof is hand-painted and uniquely numbered, and comes with a Certificate of Authenticity. Read more about the manufacturing process of the Royal Delft coin holder. Piedfort edition The numismatic term “Piedfort” is used for coins struck in double thickness. The Silver Rider is not only available in 1 ounce, but also in 2 ounce silver! Traditionally, Piedfort coins were used as a way of showing wealth and power. In the sixteenth and seventeenth century, rulers across Europe started the tradition of giving “prestige pieces” to members of their court. Nowadays, Piedfort coins are highly wanted collector’s items. Specifications Royal Delft coin holder Dimensions 110 mm diameter, 40 mm height Weight 280 g Material Earthenware Design Hand-painted and uniquely numbered Year of issue 2021
